name: Ki$$ Yourself
source:
In the basement of an abandoned house next to a data center in a ghost town a depressed loser is going to be the first person to go back in time. Erin has been given the honor of being the first time traveler....mostly because she's expendable.

Given the chance, will she turn her life around? 
Can she make any meaningful change?
Or does anything she could do really matter?

[From [url=https://jaxxie-guillotine.itch.io/kiss-yourself]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在鬼城数据中心旁边一栋废弃房屋的地下室里，一位沮丧的失败者将成为第一个回到过去的人。艾琳有幸成为第一位时间旅行者……主要是因为她是可以牺牲的。

如果有机会，她会扭转自己的人生吗？
她能做出任何有意义的改变吗？
或者她能做的事情真的很重要吗？

[来自[url=https://jaxxie-guillotine.itch.io/kiss-yourself]itch.io[/url]]
